_about: Ryu knockdown enders for fk_calc.py. KD values from the sf6-frame-kill-audit skill (ryu-verified-data.md, verified Sept 28, 2026). combo_count = how many times the ender is the final move of a combo on SuperCombo's Street_Fighter_6/Ryu/Combos page (revid 330933, last edited mid-2025, counted Sept 30, 2026; classic and Modern notation merged; alternatives like 'A/B' count once each). It is a proxy for prevalence in combos, not measured match frequency. null = no evidence (knockdowns that happen outside combos, or enders the page never ends on).

OD Hashogeki.text: Active frames disputed (Capcom 5, databases 6); rows on active 6 fail if Capcom is right. Test: LK Tatsu > whiff 5LP > OD Hashogeki, expect +8.

Denjin OD Hashogeki.text: Shares OD Hashogeki's disputed 6th active frame.

move_flags.6MP: Post-Mar-17-2026 values are derived from per-hit data, not measured. Test: LK Tatsu > whiff 5LP > 6MP, expect -1.

HK High Blade Kick.text: SuperCombo's note says the best meaty is active 7 (+3); rows on active 8-9 are unconfirmed. Test: MP Shoryuken > HK blade immediately.
